edges.reason: msg.sender selects the caller's UserIdo record in buyIdo.
msg.sender selects the caller's vesting record in withdrawZenr.
msg.sender determines the buyer record in buyBox.
msg.sender selects the reward balance in boxwithdrew.
msg.sender selects the USDT reward balance in boxwithdrewUsdt.
addMinter gates execution on msg.sender being the owner.
getRewardtokens gates execution on minters[msg.sender].
Owner state variable is compared against the caller to authorize addMinter.
minters mapping authorizes getRewardtokens.
block.timestamp bounds the IDO sale window in buyIdo.
block.timestamp determines elapsed vesting periods in canWithdrawableZenr.
block.timestamp seeds the pseudo-random value in randomnum.
buyBox invokes caucau to roll the box lottery.
caucau calls randomnum to obtain randomness.
withdrawZenr calls canWithdrawableZenr to compute the payout.
msg.sender is the payer of usdt.transferFrom in buyIdo.
msg.sender is the recipient of good.transfer in buyIdo.
msg.sender is the recipient of good.transfer in withdrawZenr.
msg.sender is the recipient of good.transfer in boxwithdrew.
msg.sender is the recipient of usdt.transfer in boxwithdrewUsdt.
msg.sender is mixed into the randomness expression, making it influenceable.
block.timestamp is mixed into the randomness expression, making it predictable.
The user parameter is the recipient of the arbitrary token transfer.
good.transfer external call executes before _user.reward is decremented, allowing reentrant boxwithdrew.
good.transferFrom external call executes before box counters and user credits are updated in buyBox.
good.transfer external call inside buyIdo can re-enter before the referral accounting completes.
usdt.transfer external call in boxwithdrewUsdt occurs between balance checks and bookkeeping.
boxinfo.hadoutnum and buytime are incremented without overflow checks in buyBox.
userido.idolen = len+1 is an unchecked increment in buyIdo.
The num parameter selects the IdoData entry used by buyIdo.
The amount parameter drives the USDT transfer and token entitlement math.
The referrer parameter seeds userUpline and referral payouts.
The amount parameter is validated and transferred in boxwithdrew.
The requested amount is forwarded to good.transfer in boxwithdrew.
The amount parameter is validated and transferred in boxwithdrewUsdt.
The _token0 parameter chooses the token transferred by getRewardtokens.
The amount parameter sets the size of the arbitrary transfer.
issuenumber selects the IdoData slot overwritten by setidoInfo.
value overwrites the usdtuint scaling unit in setusdtuint.
The needswap local is computed and stored in buyIdo.
The outnow local is credited to hisrewards in buyIdo.
outnow is the value passed to good.transfer in buyIdo.
canfraw accumulates and is returned by canWithdrawableZenr.
canfraw is the value credited and transferred in withdrawZenr.
canfraw is the value passed to good.transfer in withdrawZenr.
rand drives every lottery branch in caucau.
random is the returned pseudo-random value in randomnum.
The good token contract is the target of the transfer in buyIdo.
handleusdt is the recipient of the USDT payment in buyIdo.
boxData supply counters are read and updated in buyBox.
boxuser reward balance is read and decremented in boxwithdrew.
boxuser purchase, NFT and reward fields are written in buyBox.
useridos vesting state is read and updated in withdrawZenr.
usdtuint is the divisor in the buyIdo entitlement formula.
randNonce is read and incremented in randomnum.
days30 is the vesting period divisor in canWithdrawableZenr.
isusdt selects the payout mode branch inside caucau.
